from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/inputs/SKILL.md')
raw = p.read_bytes()
text = raw.decode('utf-8')
old = 'name: Command Development'
new = 'name: command-development'
print('exists', p.exists())
print('size', len(raw))
print('contains_old', old in text)
if old not in text:
    print('No target line found; no write attempted')
else:
    updated = text.replace(old, new, 1)
    try:
        p.write_text(updated, encoding='utf-8')
        print('WRITE_OK')
    except Exception as e:
        print('WRITE_ERR', type(e).__name__, str(e))
